architectureFlow: Spring Boot (Cloudinary Upload) -> Node AI Service (Download & Chunk) -> RAG (Tender + Bidder + ML Summary) -> Gemini LLM -> Node -> Spring Boot -> React
note: The final qualification/disqualification decision remains with the Procurement Officer.

endpoints.name: Health Check
endpoints.description: Check whether AI RAG service is running.

endpoints.name: Process Tender Document
endpoints.description: Node server downloads PDF from Cloudinary URL -> saves to upload/ -> parses text -> chunks -> generates Gemini embeddings -> stores dense vectors in pgvector.

200_OK.message: Tender document processed, vectorized, and indexed successfully.

endpoints.name: Process Bidder Document
endpoints.description: Node server downloads bidder document from Cloudinary URL -> parses text -> chunks -> generates Gemini embeddings -> stores in pgvector tagged with bidderId and documentType.

200_OK.message: Bidder document processed and vectorized successfully.

endpoints.name: Ask Bidder-Tender Chatbot
endpoints.description: Main Chatbot API. Node retrieves Tender + Bidder + ML summary context from pgvector and generates grounded Gemini evaluation response with source citations.
